subject: Upcoming Trip to Paris - Itinerary Details
body: Dear Valued Customer, We are excited to share with you the detailed itinerary for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details, hotel reservation, and local tour guide information are all included in this email. Please review the attached document for more information and feel free to reach out if you have any questions or require further assistance. We look forward to providing you with a memorable experience in the City of Light. Best regards, Travel Agency Team
